title: Woman and Boy Outdoors, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot from August 1946 depicting a young woman and a boy standing together in a grassy yard surrounded by trees. The woman is wearing a printed white t-shirt and dark trousers, smiling brightly, while the young boy wears a striped crew-neck shirt, high-waisted trousers, and a beanie cap. The photo features deckled edges characteristic of mid-20th-century photographic prints.
